Next, subtract 7 litres from the smaller tank: 242.42 - 7 = 235.42 litres.

Then, calculate the amount drained from the smaller tank: (7/45) * 235.42 = 37.3742... litres. Rounding to two decimal places, this is approximately 37.37 litres.

Finally, add 7 litres to the smaller tank: 235.42 + 7 = 242.42 litres.

Therefore, the exact volume in the smaller tank is 242.42 litres.
